name: Fernpass
kurzbeschreibung: The historic **Fernpass** at 1,211 meters connects **Außerfern** with the **Inntal** and offers a breathtaking view of the **Lechtaler Alpen**.
beschreibung: Fernpass – The Fernpass offers one of the most stunning views across the entire Alpine region. This historic pass, at 1,211 meters, connects the Außerfern with the Inntal valley and provides breathtaking vistas of the Lechtaler Alps. From the summit, a 360-degree panorama unfolds, with clear views stretching all the way to the glaciers of the Hohen Tauern on crisp days. The convenient mountain railway effortlessly brings visitors to the top, where panoramic terraces and a mountain restaurant await to be enjoyed. Just a few kilometers from Biberwier, the Fernpass invites you to explore untouched nature. The location also offers a magnificent panoramic view of the surrounding mountain ranges. Whether in summer or winter, the Fernpass is always worth a visit.
